title: Microsoft Entra ID: passkey support for B2B guest users
summary: The briefing accurately distinguishes the planned, automatic guest rollout from Learn's current statements that guest passkeys are unsupported. Its licensing, roles and operations are supported; minor corrections would complete targeting instructions, identify request-body settings beside the calls, and remove checklist controls not represented in the table.

claims.quote: B2B users, including internal guest users and external users, will be able to register and sign in with passkeys issued by a resource tenant

claims.claim: Those passkeys will satisfy the resource tenant's MFA requirements.
claims.quote: and then use it to satisfy the resource tenant's MFA requirements.
